scope: Manager-scoped diagnostic activity for each install invocation, independent of callback/debug tracking; observes the actual core promise tail and joins native cleanup/fallback; staging modSize metadata remains separate.
limitations: Exact ordered ordinary-tracking and callback-order prerequisites are mandatory; no installed app or upstream cache is modified.

Manager scopes use a nonce and checked class-wide sequence; invocation IDs are unique within the loaded class. Renderer/host-generation binding remains required across module reloads or process restarts.
Only 128 recent settled diagnostic snapshots are retained; unknown or evicted IDs are not_observed, never terminal evidence or permission.
Queued work orphaned by existing limiter clearQueue remains held; no cancellation, automatic replay, or timeout-based settlement is introduced.
Core settlement joins its error cleanup and fallback, not metadata completion, asynchronous extension listeners, deployment, dependency orchestration before install(), or host-global quiescence.
Settled activity is not success, disk-cleanup proof, archive integrity, source seal approval, native dispatch permission, or filesystem ownership proof.
The source-derived tests replace the preceding extraction/instruction pipeline with owned deferred values; no application constructor, actual install, native event or filesystem deletion runs.
Recent settled rows are diagnostic observations, not immutable durable receipts: metadataPending can change; every returned snapshot is detached.

coreTailSettled observes the attached promise tail only, not native extractor descendants, process exit, payload sealing or permission to release source files. Pre-core rejection has no observed core tail.
Mandatory cleanup is joined independently of error formatter/branch exceptions. Cleanup startup without a captured promise remains active/held; rejection is not clean-disk proof.
